definition_zh: 浮雕宝石；（影视）客串；小品式的简短出场
definition_en: a small gem carved in raised relief; also a brief, striking appearance or role by a well-known person
core_image: 一枚深色底、浅色人像浮起的小宝石胸针：小小的框里刻出鲜明的形象
scene: 首映礼上，影评人注意到海报角落里那枚祖母的浮雕胸针与女主角佩戴的一模一样。The director made a cameo in his own film.
sceneCN: 这里 cameo 是「客串」（第 2 个义项：名人短暂而醒目的出镜）；句意是这位导演在自己的电影里客串了一个角色。

pos.zh: 小品文；简短生动的描摹（罕用）

derivatives.zh: 同源借词，义为「单色多层次画法」，与 cameo 同出中世纪拉丁词形（罕用）
由名词动词化再分词构成，义为「以浮雕呈现的」（罕用）

senses.title: A gem carved in raised relief
senses.definition: a small stone, shell, or piece of jewelry carved so the design stands up in layers of different color
senses.definitionCN: 以分层色彩雕出凸起图案的小块宝石、贝壳或首饰
senses.example: She wore a Victorian cameo carved from shell.
senses.exampleCN: 她戴着一枚用贝壳雕的维多利亚时代浮雕饰件。
senses.why: The original object: a tiny frame holding one raised, sharply defined image.
senses.whyCN: 这是本源物：一个小小的框，托起一枚轮廓分明的凸起形象。

senses.title: A brief, striking appearance by a famous person
senses.titleCN: 名人客串；短暂而醒目的露面
senses.definition: a very short but memorable part played by a well-known figure in a film, show, or event
senses.definitionCN: 知名人物在影视、演出或活动中扮演的极短却令人难忘的角色
senses.example: Her cameo lasts ninety seconds and steals the film.
senses.exampleCN: 她的客串只有九十秒，却抢尽全片风头。
senses.why: A brief appearance is carved in relief against the background plot, small but standing out.
senses.whyCN: 短暂的出场就像在背景剧情上雕刻出的浮起形象，小而夺目。

senses.title: A small, vivid depiction
senses.definition: a short literary or musical piece, or a compact verbal sketch, that captures a scene sharply
senses.definitionCN: 以寥寥数笔精准呈现某一场景的短小文学作品、乐曲或语言速写
senses.example: The essay opens with a cameo of the village at dusk.
senses.exampleCN: 文章以一幅黄昏村庄的小品式速写开篇。
senses.why: The carved image stands for any miniature work that fixes one clear figure in place.
senses.whyCN: 雕出的形象可以代表任何把一个清晰画面定格下来的微型作品。

senses.title: A fleeting glimpse of a type
senses.definition: a brief instance that summarizes a whole style, era, or character in miniature
senses.definitionCN: 以缩影方式集中体现某种风格、时代或人物的一瞬
senses.example: The photograph is a cameo of the whole decade.
senses.exampleCN: 这张照片是整个十年的一帧缩影。
senses.why: Like the carved gem, one small frame concentrates the essence of something larger.
senses.whyCN: 如同雕琢的宝石，一个小小的画框浓缩了更大整体的本质。

intro.en: Cameo comes through medieval Latin camahieu from an Arabic word for a flower-shaped amulet or carving; the sense moved from carved gems to brief star turns in the twentieth century.
intro.cn: cameo 经中世纪拉丁语 camahieu 上溯到指花形护符或雕饰的阿拉伯词；二十世纪词义从雕琢宝石转向名人短暂出镜。

items.en: The suggested source is Arabic khamā'il, flower buds or a flower-shaped amulet; the exact pathway is uncertain.
items.cn: 一般认为源头是阿拉伯语 khamā'il（花蕾或花形护符），具体传播路径尚不确定。

items.en: Medieval Latin camahieu named the carved gem, preserving an unexplained vowel pattern.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语 camahieu 指这种雕琢宝石，元音形式的来源尚无定论。

items.en: The word reached English in the fifteenth century via French as cameu, cameo, for carved gems and intaglio work.
items.cn: 十五世纪该词经法语以 cameu、cameo 之形进入英语，指浮雕宝石及凹雕工艺。

items.en: By the nineteenth century cameo had broadened to mean any small, sharply focused literary portrait.
items.cn: 到十九世纪，cameo 已扩展为泛指短小而形象鲜明的文学小品。

items.en: In the twentieth century the film industry applied it to brief star appearances, now the dominant sense.
items.cn: 二十世纪电影界将其用于名人短暂客串，如今这已成为主导义项。

note.en: Cameo belongs to a small family of carving words and is easily misread against similarly spelled borrowings.
note.cn: cameo 属于一小组雕琢类词汇，且容易与拼写相近的外来词混淆。

entries.definition: A monochrome painting technique imitating carved relief; shares the medieval Latin source.
entries.definitionCN: 仿浮雕效果的单色多层次画法，与 cameo 同出中世纪拉丁语源。

entries.definition: A flowering shrub named for the botanist Kamel; only similar in sound.
entries.definitionCN: 山茶花，得名于植物学家 Kamel，只是发音相近，词源无关。

entries.definition: Relating to legislative chambers, from the same Latin camera root.
entries.definitionCN: 与议事厅相关的形容词，同出拉丁语 camera 词根。

entries.definition: The jewelry compound naming the carved pin itself.
entries.definitionCN: 珠宝类复合词，指浮雕宝石胸针实物。

entries.definition: A carving cut into the surface, the reverse technique of a raised cameo.
entries.definitionCN: 凹雕，图案刻入表面，与凸起的 cameo 雕法相反。

entries.definition: Sculpture in which the figure rises from a flat background.
entries.definitionCN: 浮雕，指形象从平面背景上凸起的雕塑形式。

entries.definition: A small acting role, though not necessarily played by a star.
entries.definitionCN: 小角色，虽戏份少但不一定由名人出演。

entries.definition: A short, lightly drawn literary or musical piece.
entries.definitionCN: 短小轻快的文学或音乐小品。

entries.definition: The featured act of a star, longer than a cameo.
entries.definitionCN: 明星的招牌出场，时长超过客串。

normalIntro.en: Five hooks on the carved-gem image and the guest-star shift of meaning.
normalIntro.cn: 五条围绕「雕琢宝石」意象与「客串」词义转化的记忆钩子。

normal.en: Original object: a cameo is a layered gem carved so the figure rises in relief.
normal.cn: 本源实物：cameo 是一块分层宝石，图案以浮雕方式凸起。

normal.en: Opposite technique: cameo rises, intaglio is cut in; remember the pair for reading questions.
normal.cn: 相反技法：cameo 凸起，intaglio 刻入；阅读题里记这一对。

normal.en: Meaning bridge: a ninety-second star appearance is a figure carved out of the background plot.
normal.cn: 词义桥梁：九十秒的名人客串就是从背景剧情里雕出来的浮起形象。

normal.en: Standard verbs: make a cameo and a cameo appearance are the collocations entertainment writing uses.
normal.cn: 标准动词搭配：make a cameo 与 a cameo appearance 是娱乐报道常用说法。

normal.en: Sound guard: camellia the flower rhymes with cameo but names a shrub, not a carving or a guest role.
normal.cn: 音形防守：camellia（山茶）与 cameo 押韵，但指植物，与雕琢或客串无关。

abstract.en: A face raised a millimeter above dark stone: small, but nothing near it competes for attention.
abstract.cn: 一张在深色石面上凸起一毫米的脸：很小，但周围没有任何东西能抢走目光。

abstract.en: A spotlight sweep across a crowded set that stops for ten seconds on one familiar face.
abstract.cn: 扫过拥挤片场的一束追光，在一张熟悉的面孔上停留十秒。

abstract.en: A pocket-sized frame holding one perfect portrait of an entire era.
abstract.cn: 一个巴掌大的画框，装着一整个时代的完美肖像。

examples.en: The pop star's cameo in the sitcom became the season's most shared clip.
examples.cn: 那位流行明星在情景喜剧里的客串成了本季转发最多的片段。

examples.en: Museums display Hellenistic cameos carved from layered agate.
examples.cn: 博物馆展出用层状玛瑙雕成的希腊化时代浮雕宝石。

examples.en: Each chapter offers a cameo of life in the port city.
examples.cn: 每一章都以小品笔法呈现这座港口城市的生活一景。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「卡米欧」——大明星卡在片场门口，米粒大的一段戏，欧耶一闪就下线，正是时间极短却抢眼的客串；联想宝石上凸起的小人像，卡（凸出）在底面上。

root: 一般认为源自阿拉伯语 khamā'il（花蕾；花形护符），经中世纪拉丁语 camahieu（雕琢宝石）传入，十五世纪经古法语进入英语。词义链：雕出凸起图案的宝石 → 十九世纪的小品式文学速写 → 二十世纪影视中的名人短暂客串。早期传播路径存在不确定，学者尚无定论。

sensesIntro.en: From carved gems in relief the word expands to brief star turns, miniature literary sketches, and emblematic glimpses.
sensesIntro.cn: 从浮雕宝石出发，词义扩展为名人短暂客串、微型文学小品以及一瞥式的时代缩影。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a small frame in which one figure is carved to stand out in relief.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个小小的框，其中一枚形象被雕得凸起夺目。

branches.en: THE VITRINE: the jewelry sense, layered stone cut in relief.
branches.cn: 展柜：珠宝义，分层宝石雕出的浮起图案。

branches.en: THE SCREEN: the guest star carved out of the background cast.
branches.cn: 银幕：从背景演员表里雕出来的客串明星。

branches.en: THE PAGE: the compact literary portrait of one scene.
branches.cn: 书页：对单个场景的紧凑文学速写。

branches.en: THE ALBUM: a single glimpse that summarizes an era or a type.
branches.cn: 相册：一个概括整个时代或类型的一瞥。

branches.en: THE CRAFT: all three share the trick of being small and unforgettable.
branches.cn: 共通技艺：小而令人难忘，是各义项共享的手法。

intro.en: Cameo is a single borrowed noun without productive prefixes or suffixes; the family lives in variant spellings and compounds.
intro.cn: cameo 是一个整体借入的名词，不带能产的前后缀；其词族体现在拼写变体与复合词上。

latinIntro.en: The medieval Latin form camahieu stands alone; beyond it the trail points to Arabic and grows uncertain.
latinIntro.cn: 中世纪拉丁语形式 camahieu 是孤立的一环；再往前线索指向阿拉伯语，愈发不确定。

items.exampleCN: 浮雕宝石（拉丁语用例示意）

items.exampleCN: 词源存疑，仅为一般认为。

items.exampleCN: 在大结局中的客串露面。

items.exampleCN: 一枚传家的浮雕宝石胸针。

items.exampleCN: 以单色多层次画法绘制。
